movie.title: I Hate Found Footage
movie.overview: When two roommates head into the woods to make a found footage movie, they stumble across something they never expected. Their low-budget film shoot quickly turns into a fight for survival in this horror-comedy.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Two roommates attempting to shoot a cheap found footage horror film in the woods find themselves fighting for real survival when an unexpected terror crashes their set.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Hoping to create a quick, low-budget found footage movie, two aspiring roommate filmmakers venture deep into the isolated woods. However, their lighthearted production takes a dark turn when they accidentally stumble upon a terrifying, real-world threat. Caught off guard and ill-prepared, their DIY movie project rapidly descends into a chaotic fight for survival. Blending dark humor and genuine horror, the duo must navigate unexpected dangers to make it out of the forest alive.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Driven by big artistic ambitions and a tiny budget, two roommates head out into the dense wilderness to shoot an independent found footage horror movie. What begins as a fun, chaotic DIY filmmaking project soon reveals the underlying creative tensions and personal drama between the two friends. As they stage cheesy scares and struggle with cheap camera gear, they unknowingly trespass into territory hiding a genuine, sinister threat. The line between fiction and reality quickly blurs when strange occurrences disrupt their shoot, forcing them to question whether their camera is capturing staged thrills or authentic horror. Before they can wrap production, the roommates stumble directly into an unexpected and deadly situation that turns their set into a battleground. With only their handheld cameras and camera lights to guide them, they are forced to drop the script and start running for their lives. As the horror escalates, comedic absurdity clashes with intense terror, testing the true strength of their friendship under extreme pressure. Ultimately, the duo must rely on their wits, resourcefulness, and each other to escape the nightmare unfolding both in front of and behind the lens.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: I Hate Found Footage is a horror-comedy drama that follows two ambitious roommates who set out into the woods to create a cheap, indie found footage movie. What starts as a humorous, improvisational film shoot rapidly turns dangerous when the duo stumbles across a genuinely terrifying presence in the wilderness. Forced to face a real threat with only their movie props and cameras, the two friends must bridge their personal differences and find a way to survive the night.

story_structure.climax: The situation escalates into an all-out, chaotic confrontation where horror tropes collide with immediate survival instincts.
story_structure.conflict: While shooting their movie, they stumble upon a genuine threat lurking in the wilderness that turns their fictional nightmare into reality.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the ordeal, the ultimate fate of the duo and their footage comes to light with a final horror-comedy twist.
story_structure.introduction: Two roommates head into the woods with low-budget equipment, aiming to make a satirical found footage horror film.
story_structure.risingAction: As tensions mount between the friends, they must navigate terrifying encounters while desperately trying to keep their cameras rolling and survive the growing danger.
